content.text: Running with restarts and BackOff warnings: the containers are being killed and restarted. Looking at the last state.

input.summary: search pods in default are OOMKilled every 12 to 15 minutes: the in-process cache grows past the 256Mi memory limit with eviction disabled, the kernel kills the container (exit 137) and the restart causes the latency spikes.
evidence: describe_pod: Last State Terminated, Reason OOMKilled, Exit Code 137, Restart Count 6, Limits memory 256Mi
pod_logs --previous: cache entries 1910000, heap_mb 252, eviction=disabled, gc pause 1.8s right before the kill
list_pods: both replicas Running with 5 and 6 restarts
input.root_cause_hypothesis: The search cache has no eviction and the heap crosses the 256Mi cgroup limit roughly every 13 minutes after warm-up; this is a memory sizing or cache-configuration regression, not a crash in the code path.
proposed_actions: Enable cache eviction or cap cache entries in the search config, and raise the memory limit to cover the real working set (the heap reached 252Mi at 1.9M entries)
next_checks: kubectl top pod -l app=search -n default to watch memory climb
compare the search ConfigMap with the version before the 3.8.0 upgrade
